newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Police exhume bodies of Brazil massacre victims.
newsitem.headline: Police exhume bodies of Brazil massacre victims.

text.p: Brazilian authorities exhumed the bodies of 19 victims of a 1993 massacre on Monday so that they could be checked for bullets, human rights activists said.
Forty-nine police officers are awaiting trial on charges of gunning down arbitrarily 21 inhabitants of Rio de Janeiro's Vigario Geral shantytown to avenge the death of four police officers.

Vera Lucia, of the Children and Adolescents Rights Defence Centre, said a decision to exhume the 19 bodies was taken after relatives of the victims found bullets in the other two bodies when they were exhumed recently.

"The original forensic examination was all wrong," Lucia said. "The relatives found six bullets in the two exhumed bodies and there shouldn't be any. The forensic experts should have removed them all."

The judge presiding over the case, Jose Geraldo Antonio, was present at the exhumation, as was forensic expert Nelson Massini, who will carry out a new autopsy if more bullets are found in the bodies.
Trials of the 49 police officers accused of carrying out the massacre are expected to take place in January.
